name: Files
description: File identity, metadata, content, and independently managed attachments.
captureExamples: Keep this PDF with my other documents.
notes: A viewer may read file metadata and content, or leave their own viewer assignment. Role recipients cannot remove other members; the owner controls membership.

Editors may update shared file metadata, append immutable content revisions, and delete only their own revisions. They cannot delete or prune the file context and thereby erase other writers' revisions.

currentContent is a link to the selected file/content revision. Clients verify the target type and parent context when resolving it; JSON Schema validates the link shape, not the existence or authority of its target.

capture.identity: Match the selected file identity and known content digest; filenames alone are not unique.
exclude: Copying a linked file merely because another module references it.
capture.workflow: Store encrypted content revisions and update currentContent deliberately; verify its target and parent when resolving it.
